summary: NPCIL video report detailing the criticality and grid synchronization of RAPP-7 (Unit 7 of the Rajasthan Atomic Power Project at Rawatbhata), India's third indigenous 700 MW PHWR, including control room celebrations, plant exterior views, Kakrapar references, and an interview segment with Station Director Shri Subrat Das.

spans.shows: Title graphic cards introducing RAPP-7 grid connection
spans.onscreen_text: RAPP-7: Powers Up / India's Third 700 MW Indigenous PHWR
spans.speech: India takes another giant leap towards energy self-reliance...

spans.shows: CGI satellite map zoom onto Rajasthan and aerial footage of Rawatbhata plant on the lake
spans.speech: ...as unit 7 of Rajasthan Atomic Power Project achieves a historic milestone.
spans.fits: Rawatbhata town and the plant on the Rana Pratap Sagar lake / Chambal river (exteriors, the lake, birds)

spans.shows: Indian engineers in a control room applauding and celebrating in front of screen showing RAPP-7 criticality diagram
spans.speech: Unit 7 of NPCIL's Rajasthan Atomic Power Project has successfully achieved its first criticality on September 19, 2024...
spans.fits: Indian engineers and workers at work (control rooms, protective suits, workshops, meetings)

spans.shows: Atomic Energy Regulatory Board (AERB) building exterior, high-voltage switchyard, power transmission towers
spans.speech: With a clearance from the Atomic Energy Regulatory Board, AERB, and passing all tests with flying colors...
spans.fits: RAPP-7 / RAPP-8 (Rawatbhata 700 MW units): construction, grid connection, fuel bundles and fuel loading

spans.shows: Exterior of 700 MW reactor building containment dome and cooling towers under clear sky
spans.speech: This is the third 700 megawatt indigenous pressurized heavy water reactor, PHWR, of its kind in India...
spans.fits: RAPP-7 / RAPP-8 (Rawatbhata 700 MW units): construction, grid connection, fuel bundles and fuel loading

spans.shows: Entrance sign and perimeter gate of Kakrapar Atomic Power Station
spans.speech: ...following the resounding success of the Kakrapar Atomic Power Station 3 and 4 in Gujarat.
spans.fits: Kakrapar (Gujarat): the 2016 shutdown news; KAPP-3/4 700 MW units, criticality July 2020, the 700 MW reactor face

spans.shows: Engineers wearing white hardhats walking down a clean facility hallway and standing in a piping gallery
spans.speech: NPCIL has mastered the art of building and operating these reactors.
spans.fits: Indian engineers and workers at work (control rooms, protective suits, workshops, meetings)

spans.shows: Close-up grid view of yellow plug caps / end fittings of fuel channels
spans.speech: With Kakrapar's two 700 megawatt PHWRs already operating at their rated power...

spans.shows: Aerial shot of Kakrapar cooling towers and plant complex
spans.speech: ...supplying clean, reliable electricity 24/7, RAPP unit 7 now joins the ranks of these high-performing reactors.
spans.fits: Kakrapar (Gujarat): the 2016 shutdown news; KAPP-3/4 700 MW units, criticality July 2020, the 700 MW reactor face

spans.shows: Lakeside view of power plant, CGI 3D model of power plant, animated Earth globe with climate text overlays
spans.speech: NPCIL's nuclear power plants not only ensure a reliable supply of electricity, but also avert carbon emissions...

spans.shows: Talking head interview with Shri Subrat Das speaking about RAPP-7 & 8 units
spans.onscreen_text: Shri SUBRAT DAS Station Director | RAPP-7&8
spans.speech: Rajasthan Atomic Power Project unit number 7 is currently under operation and subsequently Rajasthan Atomic Power Project unit number 8 will be operationalized...
spans.problems: talking head, logo bug, burned-in subtitles

spans.shows: Aerial views of reactor buildings, cooling towers, lake, zoom-out CGI globe graphics and NPCIL corporate end screen
spans.onscreen_text: TOWARDS NET ZERO BY 2070 / NPCIL / Powering Clean Energy for Today & Tomorrow
spans.speech: With this achievement, India is not only advancing its energy needs through a cleaner power source, but also contributing to the nation's mission of reaching net-zero emissions by 2070...
spans.fits: RAPP-7 / RAPP-8 (Rawatbhata 700 MW units): construction, grid connection, fuel bundles and fuel loading
